recipe:
set -e
version=$(python src/papers/bmodes/scripts/catalog_versions.py size_cut applied)
o=$(mktemp -d)
bash src/workflow/scripts/run_cosmocov_chain.sh \
  --version "$version" --blind blind_c \
  --min-sep 0.5 --max-sep 300.0 --nbins 1000 \
  --gaussian gaussian_only \
  --planck18-json results/preprint_v2/covariances/cosmology_snapshot.json \
  --emit processed --out-file "$o"/cov_integration_blind_c.txt
bash src/papers/bmodes/scripts/run_pure_eb_covariance.sh \
  --version "$version" --blind "$(python src/workflow/scripts/decision_values.py fiducial_blind blind_c)" \
  --cat-config src/cosmo_val/cat_config.yaml \
  --xi-reporting results/preprint_v2/catalog_processing/xi_reporting.txt \
  --xi-integration results/preprint_v2/catalog_processing/xi_integration.txt \
  --cov-integration "$o"/cov_integration_blind_c.txt \
  --integration-method adaptive_dqags \
  --integration-limits reporting_extent \
  --rebinning-weights none \
  --covariance-method monte_carlo \
  --out-file "$o"/pure_eb_covariance_blind_c.npz
python src/workflow/scripts/generate_cl_cov.py \
  --ver "$version" --summary results/preprint_v2/catalog_processing/catalog_summary.npz \
  --cat-config src/cosmo_val/cat_config.yaml \
  --nside 1024 --binning powspace --nbins 32 --power 0.5 --blind blind_c \
  --out-file "$o"/cl_cov_blind_c.fits
tar czf results/preprint_v2/covariances/blind_cov_scan/blind_covariances_blind_c.tar.gz -C $o .
